text: Platforms, stairs and ladders: stairs at not more than 45 degrees with a rise not more than 200 mm and a tread not less than 250 mm, handrails at 1.1 m with a mid rail and 100 mm toe plate, ladders with cages (or fall arrest rails) above 3 m and landings every 6 m; access to all valves, instruments, sample points and equipment requiring operation or maintenance more than once a year by permanent platforms or stairs, not by ladders; slip-resistant grating and no trip hazards.
